methods.label: Solve the intercept equation
methods.explanation: The x-coordinate of the intersection is the solution of the equation \(3x+9=0\), which is \(x=-3\).
methods.levelReason: The intercept-equation relationship is Grade 8 content, and the resulting equation requires only Grade 7 algebra.
